in_hebrew.name: Geraud
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Geraud הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. The name Geraud is derived from the Latin word 'gerardus', which is composed of 'ger', meaning spear or warrior, and 'wardus', meaning guard or protector. This name was popular among the Franks and the Normans, and was borne by several saints, including St. Gerard of Aurillac, a 10th-century hermit and knight.
